module: Provider node "Custom Parts Config Provider" (category `provider`). Lets you build a custom parts configuration in the editor (`partConfig = {parts, vars}`): loading from a .pc file, copying from the player vehicle (everything, parts only, variables only) then key/value editing. Outputs: `model` (string) and `config` (table of type `vehicleConfig`), usable by "Spawn Vehicle".
notes: `showKVPairs`: when a key is renamed, the variable `old` is never defined (nil), so the table is not updated correctly. On deletion, `self.partConfig.vars[...]` is used even for the `parts` field.
"Read from File" button: `partConfigFilename` receives `self.configPath` (may be nil) instead of the vehicle path.
The node writes its outputs every frame (`work`) without any notion of flow.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

_onDeserialized.desc: Called when the project loads; restores the node's settings from `nodeData`.

_onSerialize.desc: Called when the project is saved; copies the node's settings into the `res` table.

drawCustomProperties.desc: ImGui display of the node's properties in the editor panel; returns a string describing the change made, or nil.

drawMiddle.desc: ImGui display in the center of the node in the flowgraph editor; purely visual.

init.desc: Constructor; clears models/configs and creates `partConfig = {parts = {}, vars = {}}`.

showKVPairs.desc: Displays an editable table of key/value pairs (`field` = 'parts' with string values, or 'vars' with number values), with sorting, adding and deleting.

work.desc: Copies `partConfig` and `model` to the output pins `config` and `model`.
